note: TP-5721 and TP-5841. Thresholds and severities of the writing gate rows (eval l0 and eval writing) and the owner's report-only overrides. Bands are the writing lab's (sources/writing-lab-2026-11, WORKFLOW.md and DECOMPOSITION.md); human FPRs are the TP-5721 S1 calibration over the lab's creator-punctuated human scripts and talks. Severity is error, warning or report-only; a report-only row prints its value and never fails.

short-register.evidence: Lab human whole scripts: mean p10 12.2, share over 30 words p10 0.031 (n=183). Each alone flags about a tenth of humans; the conjunction is the signal. S1 on the repo segmenter: human FPR 0.047 (n=190 creator-punctuated scripts and talks); rejected scripts 8.8 and 10.7 with no sentence over 30 words; E4 pieces 20.1 / 0.139 and 20.2 / 0.153.

sentence-mean.evidence: Human mean p10 12.2 (S1: 12.3, FPR 0.074); a rejected script sits at the 8th percentile of first-400 windows, too close to the tail for an error alone.

long-share.evidence: Human share over 30 words p10 0.031 on whole scripts (S1: 0.038, FPR 0.074) but 0 on first-400 windows, so it reports only under 600 words.

first-person.evidence: Briefed pieces sit far below the human first-person rate too, so a gate would fail the pieces the gate must pass.

naming-refrain.evidence: Short naming sentences ("That is called X.", "That gas is the rise."). S1: 0 of 190 human texts reach 3, 6 reach 2 (warning FPR 0.031); rejected scripts 3 and 2; E4 pieces 0.

frame-refrain.evidence: Hand counts on one rejected series; the lab finds repeated openers do not separate. S1 human FPR 0.347, overstated since plain text is one chapter; rejected scripts 2 and 1, so it stays a warning.

staccato-run.evidence: Runs of two or more sentences of at most 6 words, per 1,000 words; the cap is the S1 human p90 (6.17, FPR 0.10). Rejected scripts 5.2 and 4.5 sit under it, so no cap both flags them and keeps human FPR at 0.10: a warning.

colon-tricolon.evidence: A colon followed by a list of three that ends the sentence. S1 any-hit human FPR 0.102, over the 0.05 an error needs: a warning. Rejected scripts 1 each; E4 s-bread 1.

teaser.evidence: "By the end of this, you'll be able to" in 4 to 6 of 12 briefed pieces and 1 of 12 bare; "N fixes change that". S1 human FPR 0.051; bread r1 1.

parallel-recap.evidence: Three or more short sentences in a row in one beat opening on the same word. S1 human FPR 0.087.

label-first.evidence: "The fix is X." The lab judge found 0 of 2 planted cases, so this row is the only signal. S1 human FPR 0.020; bread r1 1.

named-before-defined.evidence: A term a beat declares in new_terms is spoken in an earlier beat. It reads declared terms only.
